question: After the two correctness defects are fixed, should OpenClaw bundle an opt-in 1Password SecretRef provider that executes an operator-pinned external `op` binary with forwarded 1Password authentication environment?
rationale: The implementation defects have bounded repairs, but accepting a new bundled credential-execution boundary, shared SecretRef grammar change, and external runtime dependency requires explicit repository security and product intent.

options.title: Approve bundled integration
options.body: Repair both blockers, then land only after exact-head SecretRef, security, and dependency approval.

options.title: Externalize the plugin
options.body: Keep the generic plugin-managed SecretRef seam while distributing the vendor-specific integration outside OpenClaw core.

options.title: Pause for common policy
options.body: Defer until maintainers define a repository-wide policy for bundled external-CLI secret resolvers.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled integration
recommendation.body: Repair both blockers, then land only after exact-head SecretRef, security, and dependency approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged history across the shared SecretRef contract and adjacent Vault integration, including the exact alias and plugin-policy hardening relevant to this decision.
